fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) is diversifying across three businesses—rockets, satellite communications, and AI infrastructure—with Starlink subscribers reaching 13.6 million (nearly double year-over-year) driving sustained revenue growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 net income of $4.4 billion swung to profitability from a $1.1 billion loss year-ago, with Super Intelligence segment revenue reaching $7.6 billion, more than 9x the prior quarter.
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 capital expenditures of $19.6 billion focus on AI infrastructure investment, though fast payback uncertainty and high capital requirements remain key risks.
